notes.title: Happy New Year! Time to get in shape!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/ad586dc66e65a4a5fe6e2c5c480e4402a73d0e79.jpg[/img]

[b]Time to get in shape! [/b]

Play as triangles, squares and circles in Deru – The Art of Cooperation!

What's your favourite shape?

The triangle has lovely sharp corners and is the most curious of the three. It goes everywhere it can. And it always has a friend to help nearby. It favors the color red the most. 

The square is a bit blocky but uses its shape to fit in. It is very tidy and finds the best place for everything it has. It loves the color yellow.

The circe is the smoothest of all shapes and is gentle to everyone. It has often little and big gifts for it's closest friends. It is fond of color turquoise.

notes.title: Deru - The Art of Cooperation now available on PC / Mac / Linux and Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
[h1]You will never be so puzzled about something so seemingly simple![/h1]

https://youtu.be/oNEar75mEvQ

[h1]It is the November 7th DERU is finally at your virtual doorstep![/h1]

We are bursting with excitement to share DERU on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/widget/632250]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/deru-the-art-of-cooperation-switch]Nintendo Switch[/url] with you and thank you for staying with us until now. 

[b]Aaaand it’s 10% off! Hurray! [/b] 

DERU is all about inviting your friends over, getting comfy on the couch and share an amazing time together. Join the the movement, get DERU and your buddies into one room and enjoy teamplay, puzzle solving and LOOOOOOVE!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/283a1ab33cdf2fb9d1caa32e4f2db3464ea4fd40.jpg[/img]

[h1]Spread the word and let’s boost DERU to the front pages of those stores![/h1]
 
How?[list]

[*]Leave a review on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/632250/DERU__The_Art_of_Cooperation/]Steam[/url] ! ( a lot actually :) )
[*]Do the [url=https://www.facebook.com/DeruGame/]Facebook[/url] sharing is caring!

And another thing. Sometimes your best friend is out of town but you’d like to enjoy some good co-op gaming. For these situations we found a solution to still be able to co-op together: Parsec. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/632250/announcements/detail/2744275827777798329]Read the how to here[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/afa892aea1f149d6a304738a395cc6fcff14719c.jpg[/img]

All the best, happy co-opearting and thanks a lot!

Christian, Dominik, Melanie and Sam

notes.title: Play DERU online co-op with Parsec
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/66374b0f5420644b2e9ca5e6e28d8450ba106dee.jpg[/img]

Hello Hello

We are very close to the release and sooo excited to get DERU out there for everyone!
Often after a good local co-op gaming session people asked about [b]playing online co-op[/b].

We thought about the making the effort of integrating online features, but realised soon that with our limited time it would probably take us another year until we could release DERU. However we still wanted to give players the possibility to enjoy DERU together even when not being at the same location. And recently we discovered a neat tool called Parsec!

Parsec lets you stream a game to your friends and they can join via controller or keyboard as if sitting right next to you. It's quick and easy to set up, and it's also free if you host the game from your computer. We've tried it and it worked like a charm.

So there it is, how to play DERU via Parsec:
[olist]
[*] Download the client from http://parsecgaming.com
[*] Run the application and create an account. Get your friends to do the same.
[*] If you want to host, click "Add A Computer." In the setting, you can set what apps your friends can see and how to control them.
[*] To join a friend, add them using their Parsec username and request to Co-Play.
[*] Run DERU and you can play with your friends online like they're sitting next to you!
[/olist]
If you have any issues with Parsec, chat with them on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cQjEGFy]their discord channel[/url].

Also check out their Party finder channel and join [url=https://discord.gg/eTtt6Ar]our discord channel[/url] to say hi and maybe find friends to play DERU together.


Thank you so much and keep cooperating!

notes.title: Release date annouced: 7th November 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/04317c19413bf09a3422314fc28dc233e3781c4c.jpg[/img]

[h1]DERU - The Art of Cooperation ready to bend minds on November 7th[/h1]

DERU is, finally after years of development and promises of release dates, coming to Steam ( on PC, Mac and Linux) and Nintendo Switch on November 7th.

We are really happy ( like really really happy ) that we can finally show you the game in its final state and not a event-made version! 


Check out the accouncement trailer!
https://youtu.be/nIjTm-K9zh0

Deru, the awards winning co-op experience designed by Ink Kit will finally come out on Nintendo Switch and PC on November 7th after 4 years of development. In this couch co-op game, two players must team up to overcome deadly streams of shadow and light only through teamwork, timing, and tactics.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/632250/extras/Deru_Scale.png?t=1539961780[/img]


[h1]The Art of Cooperation[/h1]

Watch out for those circle streams! In Deru, the players must block streams, split themselves and juggle their mass to solve together mind-bending puzzles where communication and brains fusing will bring their co-op gaming skills to the next level. The visuals are deeply connected to the puzzles and the result are gorgeous simplistic levels whose solution is probably more than just one corner away.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/632250/extras/Deru_Split.png?t=1539961780[/img]


Soon the cooperation can begin <3!

Inkkit Team

notes.title: Strange indie games to watch from Gamescom 2018
notes.content:
There were a lot of games at Gamescom. A lot of them were good and interesting, but I didn t get enough time with them to write you thousands of words, or they re not quite done enough yet. They re a souffl that needs more time to rise. But I still wanted to tell you about them, these strange little souffl s in many different flavours. An alternate universe horror game starring Nikola Tesla. A game where you manage orphans. The most ambitious MMO that may never get made. A noir story set against the backdrop of all of creation. Please enjoy this tasting menu.

notes.title: BETA BETA
notes.content:
Hi steaming gamers

It's been a while since the steam page of DERU - The Art of Cooperation went online. Meanwhile a lot has happened here at INK KIT, we have been to multiple events showing DERU, we had a video shot for our trailer and lots of new features are now working ingame.

We let our creativity flow to make the puzzles of DERU as smooth and challenging as possible. So we improved existing puzzles and added new ones. Created a nice, stylish, minimalistic Menu. And are working on story-type levels which should round up the whole DERU play experience nicely.

[b] But actually[/b] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/c603c4e4b15fcdf259f61064d7394d9a05d5d83c.jpg[/img]
We’re starting Closed Beta on Steam! We will invite registered testers in the weeks to come. Step by step we will release further puzzles so that testers have time to give us feedback and we can include it to improve DERU.

If you didn’t inform us about your need to be part of our awesome beta test force join our [url=https://discord.gg/8SrVNTa] Discord[/url] to let us know or just talk about the game with us!
We can’t send out keys to everybody instantly ( we need to actually process all the feedback and put it into the game, so we are slowly expanding our test force ) so it might take awhile before you get a key.

About sharing and streaming, we are of course very happy if you like to share and stream material of DERU. But because it's a closed beta so please don't share or stream anything yet.

All the best

INK KIT
